brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Greece is transforming an abandoned airport site into a park with coastal vibes and green spaces. [2]
Greece has forgotten commitments from treaties it signed, with rules being ignored. [1]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GREECE
Greece's 89% net energy import dependency makes its treaty commitments on energy cooperation critical to address, yet rules are being ignored. [1][E3]

KEY RISKS
Greece's link to 21 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations could complicate international investment in the airport redevelopment project. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The outcome of the investigation into the explosion in Athens that killed four American tourists remains unresolved. [5]
